title: Near, Far, and Which Side
label: ch:cerca-y-lejos
canDo: I can say cerca, lejos, a la derecha, a la izquierda and enfrente, and say why the left-hand side is the one Spanish word in the set that is older than Rome.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C340-enfrente: place a thing near or far, send somebody right or left, and put one thing facing another.
